error[VIBE2501]: `v-model` needs a target.
  --> template/model-errors/input.vibe:2:10
2 |   <input v-model>
  |          ^^^^^^^
fix: Write the target, as in `v-model="text"`.
docs: https://vibejs.org/v0/errors/VIBE2501

error[VIBE2502]: The `v-model` target must be a variable or a property.
  --> template/model-errors/input.vibe:3:19
3 |   <input v-model="text + 1">
  |                   ^^^^^^^^
fix: Bind a `ref` or a property, as in `v-model="form.name"`.
fix: Use a value binding and an event listener for computed values.
docs: https://vibejs.org/v0/errors/VIBE2502

error[VIBE2503]: `i` is a `v-for` or `v-slot` local and cannot be assigned.
  --> template/model-errors/input.vibe:4:50
4 |   <input v-for="i in items" :key="i.id" v-model="i">
  |                                                  ^
fix: Bind a property of the item, as in `v-model="item.text"`.
docs: https://vibejs.org/v0/errors/VIBE2503

error[VIBE2504]: `label` is a prop and cannot be assigned.
  --> template/model-errors/input.vibe:5:19
5 |   <input v-model="label">
  |                   ^^^^^
fix: Declare a two-way value with `defineModel()` and bind it.
fix: Copy the prop into a `ref` and bind that.
docs: https://vibejs.org/v0/errors/VIBE2504

error[VIBE2505]: `fixed` cannot be assigned, because it is an import or a constant that holds no ref.
  --> template/model-errors/input.vibe:6:19
6 |   <input v-model="fixed">
  |                   ^^^^^
fix: Hold the value in a `ref`, as in `const fixed = ref(…)`.
fix: Bind a property of a reactive object.
docs: https://vibejs.org/v0/errors/VIBE2505

error[VIBE2506]: `v-model` is not supported on `<div>`.
  --> template/model-errors/input.vibe:7:8
7 |   <div v-model="text"></div>
  |        ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^
fix: Use `<input>`, `<textarea>` or `<select>`.
fix: Bind the value and listen to the event of the element, as in `:value` and `@input`.
docs: https://vibejs.org/v0/errors/VIBE2506

error[VIBE2507]: `v-model` cannot be used on an `<input>` with a bound `:type`.
  --> template/model-errors/input.vibe:8:23
8 |   <input :type="text" v-model="text">
  |                       ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^
fix: Write a static `type`.
fix: Render one `<input>` per type with `v-if`.
docs: https://vibejs.org/v0/errors/VIBE2507

error[VIBE2508]: `v-model` cannot be used on `<input type="file">`.
  --> template/model-errors/input.vibe:9:22
9 |   <input type="file" v-model="text">
  |                      ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^
fix: Listen to `@change` and read `event.target.files`.
docs: https://vibejs.org/v0/errors/VIBE2508

error[VIBE2509]: The `v-model` argument `x` is allowed only as a static name on a component.
  --> template/model-errors/input.vibe:10:18
10 |   <input v-model:x="text">
   |                  ^
fix: Remove the argument on native elements.
fix: Write the model name statically, as in `v-model:title`.
docs: https://vibejs.org/v0/errors/VIBE2509

error[VIBE2510]: `.foo` is not a `v-model` modifier for this element.
  --> template/model-errors/input.vibe:11:18
11 |   <input v-model.foo="text">
   |                  ^^^
fix: Remove `.foo`.
docs: https://vibejs.org/v0/errors/VIBE2510

error[VIBE2511]: `:value` cannot be combined with `v-model` on a text input.
  --> template/model-errors/input.vibe:12:10
12 |   <input :value="text" v-model="text">
   |          ^^^^^^^^^^^^^
fix: Remove `:value`.
docs: https://vibejs.org/v0/errors/VIBE2511
